about: Official pharmacy finder links and member services numbers for the insurance choices in RxLantern. Every value comes from the plan's own website (or mass.gov / medicare.gov). 'not found' means no official public page was found; nothing is guessed. 'verified' says whether the page itself was opened or the value was only seen in official search results.

plans.name: MassHealth
plans.phone_note: MassHealth Customer Service Center, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. TTY: 711. If you are in a MassHealth health plan (ACO or MCO), you can also call the number on your plan card.
plans.finder_note: MassHealth has no public pharmacy search. Most pharmacies in Massachusetts take MassHealth, but call to confirm.
plans.verified: verified via web search (mass.gov blocks automated page loads)

plans.name: Medicare
plans.phone_note: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (except some federal holidays). TTY: 1-877-486-2048. Your Part D or Medicare Advantage plan's own number is on your plan card.
plans.finder_note: Medicare's Plan Finder shows pharmacies in your drug plan's network. Your plan can also tell you.

plans.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts
plans.phone_note: Member Service. TTY: 711. Blue Cross also says you can call the Member Service number on your ID card.

plans.name: Harvard Pilgrim Health Care
plans.finder_note: Pick your plan from your ID card; Harvard Pilgrim then shows its pharmacy network (run by Optum Rx).

plans.name: Tufts Health Plan
plans.phone_note: Member Services, or the number on your member ID card.
plans.finder_note: No public pharmacy finder was found on Tufts Health Plan's website. Call Member Services to check a pharmacy.

plans.name: UnitedHealthcare
plans.phone_note: For UnitedHealthcare plans through work. TTY: 711. You can also call the number on your member ID card.
plans.finder_note: Linked from uhc.com; the pharmacy search is run by Optum Rx, UnitedHealthcare's pharmacy benefit company.

plans.name: Aetna
plans.phone_note: Aetna says: call the number on your ID card.

plans.name: Cigna Healthcare
plans.finder_note: Cigna has no public pharmacy finder; it asks members to log in to myCigna to see network pharmacies.

plans.name: Other plan
plans.phone_note: Call the member services number on the back of your insurance card.
plans.finder_note: Your plan's website or member services can tell you which pharmacies are in network.
